$comment: Per-item build status for the JHAI component catalog. PASS means the item installed, its source compiled and its imports resolved in an isolated Next project on the shadcn default neutral palette. It does NOT mean the component renders correctly with no props — most real components have required props, so routes are force-dynamic and props are spread as any. This is what the factory consumes: an item that cannot install is not a component we have.
